name: belgica
title: Belgian legal reference data
description: Courts, prisons, houses of justice, judicial areas, arrondissements and cantons with their boundaries, regions, provinces, municipalities and postal codes, the legal and commercial interest rates and the public holidays of Belgium, with their official sources.

resources.name: judicial-areas
resources.title: Judicial areas
resources.description: The 5 areas of the courts of appeal (rechtsgebieden).

sources.title: Judicial Code, annex art. 5 (numac 1967101058)

resources.name: arrondissements
resources.title: Judicial arrondissements
resources.description: The 12 judicial arrondissements and their judicial area.

sources.title: Judicial Code, annex art. 4 (numac 1967101058)

resources.name: cantons
resources.title: Judicial cantons
resources.description: All 162 judicial cantons: name, seat, the municipalities they cover and the legal description of their area, and a German name where an official German text names the canton. Generated by scripts/build-cantons.ts.

sources.title: Judicial Code, annex art. 1 (numac 1967101058), Dutch and French
Ministerial decree of 31 October 2023 on the Sankt Vith hearing location, German translation (Belgisches Staatsblatt of 18 July 2024, numac 2024006205): German name of the Eupen-Sankt Vith cantons

resources.name: canton-boundaries
resources.title: Canton boundaries
resources.description: The boundary of each of the 162 judicial cantons as GeoJSON MultiPolygon geometry (WGS 84), as the National Geographic Institute digitised it from the annex to the Judicial Code, with the NGI's identifier and canton code. Generated by scripts/parse from the weekly snapshot of the NGI's GeoPackage; the legal text in the canton's territory wins where they disagree.

sources.title: National Geographic Institute (NGI): Judicial cantons and arrondissements (Territorial Divisions), geo.be record e1f61c40-623a-11eb-9e7c-186571a04de3, revised 2026-07-16
The GeoPackage in WGS 84 (EPSG:4326) the data is built from

resources.name: arrondissement-boundaries
resources.title: Arrondissement boundaries
resources.description: The boundary of each of the 12 judicial arrondissements as GeoJSON MultiPolygon geometry (WGS 84), as the National Geographic Institute digitised it from the annex to the Judicial Code, with the NGI's identifier. Each is checked to cover the same area as the boundaries of its cantons. Generated by scripts/parse from the weekly snapshot of the NGI's GeoPackage; the legal text wins where they disagree.

sources.title: National Geographic Institute (NGI): Judicial cantons and arrondissements (Territorial Divisions), geo.be record e1f61c40-623a-11eb-9e7c-186571a04de3, revised 2026-07-16

resources.name: regions
resources.title: Regions
resources.description: The 3 regions (Flemish, Walloon and Brussels-Capital) with their Statbel REFNIS code and their names in Dutch, French and German, as Statbel publishes them. Generated by scripts/parse from the snapshots of Statbel's REFNIS code list.

sources.title: Statbel, REFNIS code list (TU_COM_REFNIS-20250101)

resources.name: provinces
resources.title: Provinces
resources.description: The 10 provinces with their Statbel REFNIS code, their names in Dutch, French and German as Statbel publishes them, and their region. The Brussels-Capital Region has no province. Generated by scripts/parse from the snapshots of Statbel's REFNIS code list.

sources.title: Statbel, REFNIS code list (TU_COM_REFNIS-20250101)

resources.name: municipalities
resources.title: Municipalities
resources.description: The 565 municipalities with their Statbel REFNIS code, province and region. Generated by scripts/build-cantons.ts.

sources.title: Statbel, population by place of residence (TF_SOC_POP_STRUCT_2026)

resources.name: courts
resources.title: Courts
resources.description: Every court of the judiciary on the courts' portal: 162 justices of the peace, the police courts, courts of first instance, enterprise and labour courts, courts of appeal, labour courts of appeal and courts of assize, with their divisions; names as published, address, registries' contacts, opening hours and ECLI codes. Generated by scripts/parse from the snapshots.

sources.title: Cours & Tribunaux / Hoven & Rechtbanken (College of Courts and Tribunals)
ECLI codes: published Belgian decisions (openjusticebe/ecli) and e-justice.europa.eu
Cantons each court covers: Judicial Code, annex art. 3–5 and art. 114 (numac 1967101058)

resources.name: court-locations
resources.title: Court locations
resources.description: A GeoJSON Point (WGS 84) for each justice of the peace, from the National Geographic Institute's peace court layer, with the address the NGI placed it at. A point is kept only when that address has the house number of the court's own address on the courts' portal, so courts that moved since the NGI's last update have none. Generated by scripts/parse/court-locations.ts from the weekly snapshot of the NGI's GeoPackage.

sources.title: National Geographic Institute (NGI): Judicial cantons and arrondissements (Territorial Divisions), geo.be record e1f61c40-623a-11eb-9e7c-186571a04de3, revised 2026-07-16
The GeoPackage in WGS 84 (EPSG:4326) the data is built from

resources.name: prisons
resources.title: Prisons
resources.description: The prisons and detention houses of the FPS Justice, with their names in the three languages, address and contacts. Generated by scripts/parse from the snapshots.

sources.title: FPS Justice: Belgian prisons

resources.name: houses-of-justice
resources.title: Houses of justice
resources.description: The houses of justice of the Flemish and French Communities, with address and contacts. The German-speaking Community's house in Eupen is not in the data yet. Generated by scripts/parse from the snapshots.

sources.title: Flemish Community: Justitiehuizen
Fédération Wallonie-Bruxelles: Maisons de justice

resources.name: postal-codes
resources.title: Postal codes
resources.description: Every pair of a postal code and the municipality it belongs to, by REFNIS code: 1 149 postal codes, three of which (1040, 1050, 1804) belong to two municipalities. Generated by scripts/parse from the snapshots of Statbel's conversion table.

sources.title: Statbel, conversion table postal code – REFNIS code, valid from 1 January 2025

resources.name: interest-rates
resources.title: Legal and commercial interest rates
resources.description: The legal interest rate (per calendar year, since 1970) and the rate for late payment in commercial transactions (per semester, since 2002).

sources.title: FOD Financiën: rentevoet betalingsachterstand handelstransacties
Belgisch Staatsblad: annual notice of the legal interest rate

resources.name: public-holidays
resources.title: Legal public holidays
resources.description: The rules for the ten legal public holidays (three of them depend on Easter), for moving the last day of a deadline to the next working day (art. 53 Judicial Code), and the years a holiday was moved.

sources.title: Wet van 4 januari 1974 betreffende de feestdagen (numac 1974010407)
KB van 18 april 1974, art. 1: the ten holidays (numac 1974041801)
Judicial Code, art. 50 and 53: deadlines (numac 1967101052)
Judicial Code, art. 334: the judicial year and holidays (numac 1967101053)
